visual.criterion: Render the five Frozen states with their correct state PNG, hierarchy, copy and state-specific Hero dimensions.
visual.method: Compare the state to its exact registered Frozen visual asset and layout geometry.
visual.pass_condition: High 322×210; Medium/Low 322×178; No Fish 322×245; Image Quality 322×214 at 360dp, with declared page-safe adaptation.

visual.criterion: Hero media mode matches state: subject-safe for High/Medium/Low and complete Evidence Fit for No Fish/Image Quality.
visual.method: Inspect source orientation, safe rectangle and displayed crop.
visual.pass_condition: No stretch, generated fill, classifier crop or clipped evidence.

visual.criterion: Image Quality state, reason, gate value and copy resolve through ImageQualityCopy_V1.json.
visual.method: Compare actual issue reason codes to approved recovery copy decision.
visual.pass_condition: Only GOOD/WARNING/INVALID are used; six reason codes follow their mappings; no unmeasured diagnosis, paraphrase or Frozen PNG edit.

interaction.criterion: Medium candidate remains a suggestion until explicitly selected; selector returns to the same Result state.
interaction.method: Open Medium, tap a candidate and separately exercise Other Species/cancel.
interaction.pass_condition: No automatic confirmation; confirmed species is explicit; cancel preserves Result context.

interaction.criterion: Low unresolved CTA gates persistence through LOW_MANUAL; selection resumes only the requested action.
interaction.method: Test Save and Continue Memory separately, then return unconfirmed.
interaction.pass_condition: No unknown species record; draft preserved; pending destination cleared on unconfirmed return.

interaction.criterion: Successful Save Catch persists once then routes Home; Detail is opened later from an allowed entry point.
interaction.method: Complete ordinary Save Catch and inspect route/record count.
interaction.pass_condition: No direct Detail route from Save Catch; one persisted record.

interaction.criterion: Continue Memory remains a distinct action that enters Detail memory only after record persistence.
interaction.method: Complete Continue Memory and inspect route and record identity.
interaction.pass_condition: FishRecord exists before Detail; initial section is MEMORY.

interaction.criterion: Save error stays on Result, preserves all draft fields and prevents duplicate records.
interaction.pass_condition: Fields and destination survive; one record maximum.

accessibility.criterion: All shared actions/selector/search/sheets retain registered minimum hit target, focus and accessible state.
accessibility.method: Measure and inspect the shared component contracts at the registered viewports.
accessibility.pass_condition: At least touch.minimum where applicable; focus enters/restores from modal; control role/state is announced.

accessibility.criterion: FontScale and compact-height behavior follow the Result responsive/accessibility matrix.
accessibility.method: Inspect declared type scale and compact-height variant against the approved page matrix.
accessibility.pass_condition: Large text reflows/scrolls; active field and actions remain reachable; no unregistered type override.

accessibility.criterion: Candidate Card, CTA, Metadata Row and Bottom Sheet meet the responsive/accessibility matrix.
accessibility.method: Review 320/360/411dp, large font, TalkBack, keyboard and orientation rows; verify 44×44dp Shared Foundation touch minimum.
accessibility.pass_condition: Every required row has a frozen measurable contract; runtime remains NOT_RUN.

error.criterion: No Fish and Image Quality recovery never creates a FishRecord; Retake/Gallery return to Capture.
error.method: Trigger each issue state and each recovery action.
error.pass_condition: No persistence; correct image-source handoff to Capture.

error.criterion: Network/persistence error preserves field values and requested destination and offers retry without duplicate creation.
error.method: Simulate failure before record creation, then retry once.
error.pass_condition: Result remains visible with saved draft and one record maximum.

error.criterion: Every UI field maps through Result Data Contract to a named Source Owner.
error.method: Compare Recognition_Result_Data_Lineage_V1.json with Data Contract fields and optional/error/fallback behavior.
error.pass_condition: Required eight mappings and displayed interaction fields resolve; no API/DB schema is inferred.
